column1: # BabelSoft Script Data: Unicode Collation Algorithm tables
#   One block per table; the line after [name] names that block's columns.
#   Codepoints are U+XXXX, weights are hexadecimal 0x....
#     the level-1 weight of a codepoint is l1 + (cp - cp_first), while l2/l3
#     tailorings, tibetan_initial): c1, c2, c3, l1, l2, l3, where '-' is the
#     absent codepoint of a shorter contraction.  A row whose three weights
#     are all zero only affects reordering.
